FAIR PLAY NOTICE\nSome online games forbid or detect input-mapping tools. Use at your own risk and prefer single-player or custom rooms. R.SHMap only converts keyboard/mouse input to normal touches; it has no aimbot, recoil script, memory access or anti-cheat bypass, and never will.

FAQ

• Mouse still shows a cursor / does nothing?
Pointer capture needs the overlay to have focus. Tap the bubble to toggle Game Mode off and on, and make sure only one mouse is connected through OTG.

• Game pauses when Game Mode starts?
Some games pause when another window takes focus. Use Shizuku backend or try a different game mode toggle timing; this is a known limitation.

• Accessibility switch greyed out (Android 13+)?
Open Settings > Apps > R.SHMap > ⋮ menu > "Allow restricted settings", then enable the service.

• Samsung: Settings > Apps > R.SHMap > Battery > Unrestricted. Also remove the app from "Sleeping apps".
• Xiaomi/Redmi/Poco: enable Autostart, "Display pop-up windows while running in background" and Battery saver > No restrictions.
• Oppo/Realme/OnePlus: allow Auto-launch and Background activity; pin the app in recents.
• Vivo/iQOO: enable High background power consumption and Autostart.

• Camera drifts or sticks?
Lower sensitivity or raise smoothing; check Diagnostics for your mouse polling rate.

• Joystick feels slow to start?
Lower the joystick ramp in the editor (Opts) or set it to 0.

• Hotkey does not work?
It is handled by the Accessibility service; make sure it is enabled. Default is F1, change it in Settings.
